title: Pullman National Historical Park: Road Construction Near the Park
summary: There is road construction near the park visitor center along 111th St. and S. Cottage Avenue. Please use caution and allow extra travel time when visiting. Construction is expected to last through the fall. In addition, on occasion the vehicle entrance for parking at 610 E. 111th street is limited to one lane.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Partial Trail Closure at Portage Lakefront and Riverwalk
summary: Closed portion of Portage Lakefront and Riverwalk Trail along Burns Waterway due to unsafe conditions from erosional damage. This trail portion will remain closed while funding is sought for repair work. Pier access remains open on either side of closure.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Partial Closures to Little Calumet River Trail and Glenwood Dunes Trail
summary: Marquette Greenway construction will require closing sections of the Glenwood Dunes Trail (April–December 2026) and Little Calumet River / Mnoké Prairie Trail (May–December 2026). Closure dates may shift as work progresses. Please follow all posted closures and check the park website or NPS App for updates.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Water Safety Alert
summary: After recent storms, E. coli levels are likely to reach above safe swimming standards. Entering the water after heavy rainfall is never recommended. Know before you go and always check our Beach Safety page before heading to park beaches.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Closure - Heron Rookery Trail
summary: Closed. The trail is undergoing tree removal and rerouting due to riverbank collapse. It is expected to reopen in the fall, after mosquito activity decreases.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Closure - Hobart Woodland Trail
summary: Closed. The Woodland Trail is closed indefinitely, and no reopening date is available. However, the paved Oak Savannah Trail remains open.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Other Park Conditions and Updates
summary: For more information on storm related repairs and other park conditions like beach and hiking safety visit our park status page.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Partial Closure - Upland Trail
summary: The middle boardwalk was lost due to a tree strike, making the full loop inaccessible. At this time, there is no timeline for replacement.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Partial Trail Closure - Dunewood Trace
summary: Partially open. Persistent flooding west of the campground currently limits access to the entire trail. Hikers may not always be able to traverse the full length.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park: Partial Trail Closures on Bailly / Chellberg Trail
summary: Portions of Bailly / Chellberg Trail (with stairs) will be closed through October (10/30/26), to allow completion of boardwalk replacement project.

title: Indiana Dunes National Park
summary: Lake Michigan's might has influenced Indiana Dunes for millennia. Wind and waves have shaped the land, leaving a rich mosaic of habitats along these 15 miles of Indiana coast. Over 50 miles of trails lead through shifting sand dunes, quiet woodlands, sunny prairies and lush wetlands. Known for its striking plant and bird diversity, it's easy to find inspiration throughout the park’s 16,000 acres.

title: Pullman National Historical Park
summary: In a growing Chicago neighborhood, diverse people and stories intertwined. All were seeking opportunity. Some succeeded. Others were limited—by race, gender, or economic status. Their stories came together in Pullman, a planned industrial community famed for its urban design and architecture.
